in_marathi.name: Sunu
in_marathi.long_meaning: Sunu हे एक हिंदू नाव आहे जे भारतीय संस्कृतीत खोल आध्यात्मिक महत्त्व ठेवते। The name Sunu is derived from the Sanskrit word 'Surya', which means 'sun'. It is a beautiful and meaningful name for a baby girl, symbolizing radiance, energy, and light.

in_bengali.name: Sunu
in_bengali.long_meaning: Sunu একটি হিন্দু নাম যা ভারতীয় সংস্কৃতিতে গভীর আধ্যাত্মিক তাৎপর্য রাখে। The name Sunu is derived from the Sanskrit word 'Surya', which means 'sun'. It is a beautiful and meaningful name for a baby girl, symbolizing radiance, energy, and light.
